About WevTEC · Fix Website Issues

Houston’s Website Repair & SEO Team, Fixing Websites Since 2013

We find what’s broken, fix it at the root, and don’t ask you to pay a dime until it’s done.

For more than a decade, business owners across Houston and the United States have called us when their website stopped working, got hacked, or quietly disappeared from Google. We jump on a live screen-share, check the errors in real time, and explain exactly what’s wrong in plain English before we touch a single file.

Book a Free Consultation
Call (832) 266-7209
  • Registered in Texas
  • No upfront charge
  • Live error checks
  • USA-based support

Who We Are

A small, senior team that treats your website like our own business

WevTEC started in Houston in 2013 with a simple idea: when a business website breaks, the owner deserves a straight answer and a real fix, not a sales pitch. Today, Fix Website Issues by WevTEC is the website repair, technical SEO and AI-search visibility practice behind 1,000+ repaired websites and 500+ websites designed or redesigned, for businesses across Houston and clients from Miami to Los Angeles.

We’re not a call center and we don’t hand you off to a junior tech. You work directly with experienced engineers who diagnose WordPress crashes, hacked sites, broken checkouts, hosting and SSL errors, slow pages and ranking drops every single day.

Our promise hasn’t changed since day one: we check your errors live, we explain the fix in plain English, and there’s no upfront charge. You pay once your website is working again.

Names you may see: Fix Website Issues, FixWebsiteIssues.com, WevTEC and Bizzsol LLC all refer to the same business. Fix Website Issues is the website repair, technical SEO and AI search service of WevTEC, the assumed business name (DBA) of Bizzsol LLC, a Texas company headquartered in Houston and operating since 2013.

What we are not: we are not a web hosting provider, domain registrar, plugin or theme vendor, or an informational blog, and we are not affiliated with WordPress.org, Automattic, Google or Cloudflare. Our guides are written by the people who do the repairs.

We work remotely with businesses across the United States. Call (832) 266-7209 or email info@fixwebsiteissues.com.

Company facts

  • Business name: WevTEC (Fix Website Issues)
  • Legal entity: WevTEC is a DBA of Bizzsol LLC
  • Registered in the State of Texas
  • Headquarters: Houston, Texas
  • In business since 2013
  • Phone: (832) 266-7209
  • Email: info@fixwebsiteissues.com

Why Businesses Choose Us

The way website repair should work

Six commitments we’ve kept with every client since 2013.

Live error checks

We review your site with you on a live call, reproduce the error, and show you what’s causing it. No guesswork, no black box.

No upfront charge

You don’t pay to get started. We fix the problem first, confirm it with you, and invoice once your site is working.

Expert SEO consultation

From ranking drops and indexing errors to Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT visibility, we explain what’s holding you back.

Root-cause repairs

We don’t just make the error message go away. We find why it happened so it doesn’t come back next week.

Backup before every change

We create or verify a full backup before significant work, so your content, orders and data stay protected.

Direct access to senior engineers

You talk to the person fixing your site. Clear updates, honest timelines and USA-based support.

How We Work

Four simple steps from “it’s broken” to “it’s fixed”

01

Tell us what’s wrong

Call, text or book a free consultation. Share your website URL and what you’re seeing.

02

Live diagnosis

We check the errors with you in real time and explain the root cause and recommended fix.

03

Backup & repair

We secure a backup, make the fix and test everything that could be affected.

04

Pay after it’s fixed

You confirm the result. Only then do we invoice. No upfront charge, no surprises.

Where We Work

Rooted in Houston. Serving clients nationwide.

Most website problems can be diagnosed and repaired remotely and securely, so location is never a barrier. Alongside our home base in Houston, we have extensive client coverage in Miami, Atlanta, New York and Los Angeles, and we support businesses in every state across the country.
